thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert — elevated 500s for customer-facing /v1/generate and /v1/embed routes. Error spike started ~10s ago. Alert group: routing-fallback.
Olivia: oncall here, acked. I'm looking at the routing rules + pinned versions now.
Samir: thx — I'm pulling the headers from the failing requests. Can someone check the fallback logs?
Leo: I see a surge of `model_incompatible` errors in the fallback worker. Mostly for requests with `accept: application/vnd.openai.embeddings` and `content-type: text/plain`.
Anna: customer impact: Maria from CS flagged two paying customers reporting timeouts and 503s around the same time. Maria, can you confirm which endpoints they hit?
Maria-cs: both called embeddings endpoint for vector search. One is doing bulk indexing. Impact: partial indexing failures, retries flooding. Customer-visible error: "model error: incompatible variant".
Olivia: preliminary hypothesis: a pinned model version for the tenant points to a chat/generation variant while routing policy tried to fallback from an embeddings-only variant -> incompatible code path.
Samir: found the tenant pin: `tenant: acme-prod` pinned to `open-redwood-chat-1.2.0`. The routing policy attempted embed fallback to `open-redwood-embed-1.0.0` but the pin was reversed (pin pointed to chat var); when capacity was low, fallback routing tried to satisfy with `open-redwood-gen-1.0.0` causing schema mismatch and 500s.
Leo: here's the log snippet from fallback worker: ```
WARN routing/fallback.go:142 tenant=acme-prod desired=embed variant=embed-1.0.0 pinned=chat-1.2.0 compatible=false
ERR runtime/serve.go:87 serve error: incompatible-model-ops: attempted text generation on embed request
```
Anna: can we temporarily lift the tenant pin or route acme-prod to dedicated embed pool?
Olivia: quick mitigation plan: 1) pin override rollback for acme-prod to remove the broken pin 2) add an interstitial policy to block cross-type fallback (embed <-> gen) for 15 minutes 3) scale embed pool if needed. I'll action 1 and 2 now.
Samir: thumbs. Olivia — to remove pin do you want me to run the admin API so it's auditable? I can run: ```
POST /admin/tenants/acme-prod/pin/remove
{ "actor": "olivia-oncall", "reason": "emergency rollback - incompatible pin" }
```
Olivia: please run it and paste output. I'll watch metrics and traces.
Samir: running now...
deploy-bot: POST /admin/tenants/acme-prod/pin/remove accepted — job id 48722.
Samir: job 48722 completed: status=success. Pin removed.
Olivia: applying temporary policy to disallow embed->gen fallback: ```
PATCH /admin/policies/routing/temporary-guard
{ "match": "*", "deny_fallback_pairs": [["embed","gen"],["embed","chat"]], "ttl":"15m", "actor":"olivia" }
```
Olivia: policy patched, TTL 15m.
Leo: metrics: error rate on embeddings route dropped ~80% within 30s. Latency back to normal for non-retried calls.
Anna: Maria, can you tell affected customers we've applied an emergency change and we're monitoring? Any requests from them retrying?
Maria-cs: notified both customers. One reports their bulk job resumed after retries, the other still has partial failures for 2 of 120 shards but will retry. They appreciate the quick fix.
Samir: root cause summary (working): a config drift during a prior rollout left a stale pin mapping for acme-prod pointing to a chat variant. When embed-compatible capacity dropped, smart routing attempted fallback across variant types; the compatibility check failed late in the pipeline leading to 500s instead of graceful reject or reroute to safe fallback.
Olivia: follow-ups in-flight: 1) create automated validation that pins must match request capability (embed/chat/gen) at commit time 2) add a pre-fallback gate that rejects cross-purpose fallback earlier with 4xx and clear log message 3) create alert rule for sudden rise in `incompatible-model-ops` errors.
Samir: I'll open the GitHub tasks now and link to this thread.
Samir: created issue RID-912: "prevent cross-variant fallback; validate pinned variant compatibility" — assigned to eng-runtime.
Leo: quick note — we should also add a short-lived metric for pin-removal/changes to detect accidental drifts during rollouts.
Olivia: agreed. Also need a postmortem with timeline + customer impact. I'll draft and include remediation, RCA and detection gaps.
Maria-cs: I'll coordinate customer notes and provide the list of affected tenants.
Anna: did we take any capacity action? I didn't see autoscale firing.
Olivia: autoscale didn't kick because embed pool hit per-tenant quota; I'm increasing pool cap as a buffer: scaling embed pool +20% for 10m.
deploy-bot: embed-pool scale requested by olivia: new-target=+20% duration=10m job=48724 accepted.
Leo: verifying traces — requests now fail-fast on policy gate when incompatible instead of internal 500s. That's better for clients.
Samir: adding a small test harness to simulation that will try pinned mismatches and assert fallback rejects.
Olivia: handing off to next oncall @anna in 10m. Please own follow-ups: ensure RID-912 triaged and pages to eng-runtime if severity escalates, and coordinate CS comms.
Anna: ack, taking handoff. I'll stay on this for the next hour and update postmortem draft.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (reduced customer errors, mitigations in place). Duration: ~3m. Severity: SEV2.
Olivia: thanks team. We'll write a full incident report and include the config diff that introduced the stale pin.
Maria-cs: customer follow-up scheduled for tomorrow EOD. :white_check_mark:
Samir: logs and full stack trace uploaded to RID-912.```
